title: OPT 374 Human Visual Perception: Depth Perception extension bank

objectives.statement: Define depth, absolute depth and relative depth.
Explain everyday risk and opportunity functions of depth perception.
Differentiate monocular from binocular depth judgments and distance ranges.
Identify and apply relative size, texture, occlusion, perspective, shadow, clarity, motion parallax and height cues.
Interpret Ebbinghaus, Ponzo and Moon illusions using depth/size-constancy logic.
Explain convergence and oculomotor cue logic.
Explain retinal disparity, Panum’s fusional space, crossed/uncrossed disparity and physiologic diplopia.
Explain stereopsis and binocular overlap as sources of solid 3-D vision.
Compare near and distance stereopsis tests and interpret stereoacuity thresholds.
Evaluate Randot/PASS/telebinocular lab tasks, monocular cue cheating, +4.00 D blur and chromostereopsis prompts.
